scheme.title: Museum of One Local Discovery Vocabulary
scheme.editorial_owner: Museum of One Digital Archive Library
scheme.scope_note: A maintained local vocabulary for consistent access to this selected Museum of One corpus. Definitions describe how terms are used here; they do not replace source wording or claim external authority endorsement.
scheme.maintenance_note: New labels require a documented scope, source warrant, and review before assignment. Stable local identifiers are retained when labels change. External mappings require a checked authority record and an explicit relationship.
